idea-plugin.name: FITS Viewer Pro
idea-plugin.description:
A professional-grade FITS (Flexible Image Transport System) file viewer for the IntelliJ Platform.

Features:
  • High-Performance Rendering: View large FITS images with zero lag.
  • Advanced Stretching: Linear, Log, Sqrt, and Asinh (Inverse Hyperbolic Sine) stretching for high-dynamic-range data.
  • Coordinate System: Full WCS support with professional HMS/DMS coordinate readouts.
  • Compressed FITS: Built-in support for .fits.fz (Rice-compressed) files.
  • Multi-HDU Support: Easily switch between primary images, extensions, and metadata tables in a single file.
  • Analysis Tools: Interactive histogram, crosshair, and measurement tool.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0
  • Initial release of the FITS Viewer plugin.
  • Displays FITS header keywords and values in a table.
  • Shows primary image data with a 5th-95th percentile linear stretch.
